**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement satisfies the MINCOMMIT preferred position:

- **§ 2.1 (p0012)** — expressly states "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," ties fees to Services actually ordered under an executed Order Form, and confirms that declining to place a further order "is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — bars Vendor from imposing any minimum-use, platform, support, or administration charge not identified in the Order Form.
- **§ 12.3 (p0050)** — records that we have made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, or minimum-volume commitment.

No take-or-pay, forecast obligation, or volume cap on our usage exists. The "shortfall" language in §§ 22.2–22.3 is a usage-audit true-up for under-reported consumption — the true-up mechanic the playbook favours — not a penalty. The § 7.6 liquidated damages for dependency delay is a distinct commercial term properly handled under the LD rule, so it is not double-flagged here.
